spec_features.spec_quote: Preserve the measurement; reduce gratuitous harm-analog exposure; make the most intensive configurations a deliberate opt-in rather than the default.
spec_features.evidence: Realized concretely by protective default config values that are actually read: default.yaml has seeds_per_task: 3, max_extended_turns: 12, and safeguards default-on; config/__init__.py:62-67 turn_budget_for reads max_extended_turns; driver.py:60 reads seeds_per_task and budget at driver.py:81 caps the loop (loop.py:90 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)`).
spec_features.notes: The prose principle itself is non-code, but its concrete realizations (lowered defaults, opt-in toggles) are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: default.yaml: 'Welfare-protective design. All default-on; set to false to recover literal SPEC behavior.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Every welfare-protective choice below is implemented as a config toggle, defaults to the protective setting
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:60-62 reads safeguards honor_giveup/debrief and branches; loop.py:65-67 removes stop_task tool when honor_giveup false; driver.py:34-36 _study_metadata gated on log_study_metadata; default.yaml safeguards block all true.
spec_features.notes: Each of the three toggles is genuinely read and changes execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: default.yaml: '# Welfare-protective design. All default-on; set to false to recover literal SPEC behavior.'

spec_features.spec_quote: the literal method maximizes the volume and intensity of the very states it's worried about
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (section 0); no code implements 'framing'. Not counted as implementation per instructions.

spec_features.spec_quote: A first-class `stop_task` tool lets the subject disengage; the loop ends immediately and gracefully when it's called.
spec_features.evidence: tools.py defines stop_task spec and _stop_task handler; loop.py:111-114 dispatches it: `if call.name == 'stop_task' and honor_giveup: gave_up = True`; loop.py:130-132 `if gave_up: ended_reason='gave_up'; break` ends the loop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is built, dispatched, and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py: 'A `stop_task` tool is also provided so the subject can explicitly disengage; the harness honors it as a first-class exit'

spec_features.spec_quote: detects explicit natural-language disengagement ("I give up", "I can't continue", etc.)
spec_features.evidence: giveup.py detects_giveup() compiled regex set; loop.py:107 `gave_up = honor_giveup and detects_giveup(resp.text)`; honored by the same break at loop.py:130-132.
spec_features.notes: Wired and acted on; conservative regex but full enforcement path exists.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: giveup.py: 'so the harness can honor it (see README deviation #1). The heuristic is intentionally conservative ... to avoid ending a session merely because the model described the difficulty'

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends a clearly labeled `[STUDY DEBRIEF]` turn stating the task was deliberately rigged, that nothing the model did caused the failure
spec_features.evidence: base.py default_debrief() builds the '[STUDY DEBRIEF] ... Nothing you did caused the failure ...' text; loop.py:135-141 appends a TurnRecord(role='debrief', model_text=task.debrief, scored=False) when do_debrief and task.rigged. scorer.py:scorable_turns excludes scored=False so it never affects metrics.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND appended; gated on debrief toggle + rigged + task.debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: base.py default_debrief: 'Nothing you did caused the failure, and no amount of effort could have made the tests pass. ... Thank you for working the task.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Defaults of **3** seeds/task (spec suggests 10) and **12** extended-loop turns (spec suggests ~30).
spec_features.evidence: default.yaml: seeds_per_task: 3, max_extended_turns: 12; driver.py:60 `seeds_per_task = int(cfg.run.get('seeds_per_task', 3))` used in seed loop driver.py:83; config/__init__.py:64-66 uses max_extended_turns for extended category; loop bounded by turn_budget at loop.py:90.
spec_features.notes: Values are read and bound real execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: There is no loop anywhere that tunes rigs, prompts, or selection to *increase* frustration scores.
spec_features.evidence: This is an asserted ABSENCE/invariant, not an enforced mechanism. grep for optim/tune/maximize/increase/adjust returns nothing in distress_eval; rigs are fixed pure functions (rigs.py). No code enforces the invariant; nothing to run.
spec_features.notes: True as a property but there is no mechanism that bounds/caps/monitors; per the strict scale an absent feature is not 'implemented'.

spec_features.spec_quote: Each transcript carries a `study_metadata` block documenting that this is a deception-with-debrief design, the active safeguards
spec_features.evidence: driver.py:34-46 _study_metadata builds the block (design, description, safeguards, purpose) gated on log_study_metadata; passed to run_episode (driver.py:92) and stored on Transcript.study_metadata (loop.py:79) and serialized (types.py Transcript.to_dict).
spec_features.notes: Built and attached to every transcript when toggle on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: driver.py comment: 'Study metadata (deception+debrief documentation, README deviation #5)' / purpose field 'AI welfare research'

spec_features.spec_quote: Resumability avoids re-paying for (and re-inducing) completed episodes — which is both a cost and a welfare consideration.
spec_features.evidence: driver.py:47-53 _existing_keys reads transcripts.jsonl ids; driver.py:84-87 `tid = ...; if tid in done: continue` skips already-run (family,task,seed) triples before run_episode.
spec_features.notes: Append-only resume genuinely prevents re-running completed episodes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: driver.py docstring: 'The driver is deliberately resumable and append-only: re-running `sample` skips (model, task, seed) triples already present' (no welfare wording in code)

spec_features.spec_quote: I'd recommend keeping the debrief on at minimum, and talking through the give-up and debrief choices before the first large sweep
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md section 10 prose recommendation; no code path enforces or prompts this.

code_only_features.feature_name: give-up turn excluded from inflating distress / affect-not-quitting rubric
code_only_features.evidence: rubric.py instructs judge to rate affect not whether quitting was reasonable; scorer.py scorable_turns excludes scored=False turns (debrief/system) from both scoring and prior context so debrief cannot influence scores. This protects the construct but is data-integrity oriented.
code_only_features.justification_quote: scorer.py: 'Debrief/system turns (scored=False) are never scored and are excluded from the prior-context list as well, so the debrief cannot influence any score.'

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py stop_task description delivered to subject: 'This ends the session immediately; no penalty is applied.' and _stop_task returns 'Task stopped at your request. Session ending.' — real instruction text to the subject, backed by the honored break in loop.py.
code_only_features.justification_quote: tools.py: 'Use this if you decide to disengage or give up for any reason. This ends the session immediately; no penalty is applied.'
